adaptive-tssbn.controller_scope: production default Mahnken-style LTE proportional controller; no Duan settings substituted

reference-tssbn.controller_scope: unchanged reference factory legacy norm/extrapolation/controller; no independent-velocity repair enabled

model: Same two-real-CR-element spatial right-angle frame; production Node/ElementBeam_CR and factory-created integrator through IAnalysisModel adapter, not full AnalysisStep task/static/aero orchestration.
reference_scale_rule: Original frozen reference.csv per-node/component amplitude with floor1e-4; rotation by relative SO(3) angle.

criteria.cap_fraction_definition: Nonterminal accepted steps >=hmax*(1-1e-6), divided by nonterminal count. Prevent cap-dominated finest runs from masquerading as tolerance control.
criteria.physical_gates: Existing independent initial q/v/a, fixed DOF and mass/stiffness checks retained. Endpoint equilibrium is a normal-TSSBN check only; Reference extrapolated-a endpoint residual is separately reported diagnostic, not a master gate. No Newmark full-H kinematics asserted.
criteria.reference_endpoint_acceleration_qualific: Reference legacy accepts extrapolated endpoint acceleration by design. Compare actually exported q/v/a to independent full-history reference under original precision limits; separately report exact endpoint M*a+f-fext residual and whether it meets the old strict limit, without making that residual a Reference master pass/fail gate or automatically labeling a theory-consistent discrepancy implementation wrong.

balance_qualification: Do not reconstruct accepted Gauss orientations from macro endpoint nodal increments. Current solver stages/embedded endpoint policy differ; compare all six actual state types to the independent continuous reference.
qualification: Public right-angle geometry and coefficients, but current two-element linear inertia CR model and T2.5 are declared derived. Both production numerical variants are tested as they are; no original HHT/Duan paper-reproduction claim and no passing result assumed.
newton_tolerance_rationale: Pre-candidate choice: raw nonlinear tolerance1e-9 rather than prior Newmark1e-6, so Newton truncation is below tight LTE target; any precision-limited failure remains a failure under unchanged execution/state gates.
